header.intro: Embedded Linux, robotics and cybersecurity: from hardware to validation.

aboutme.aboutme-third-title: R&D engineer in electronics, embedded systems and advanced sensing.
aboutme.aboutme-first-paragraph: R&D engineer specialising in embedded cybersecurity and certification of connected devices. Experience in IoT platform evaluation, test automation and validation of critical security mechanisms in Linux environments and low-power systems. Solid foundation in firmware, sensing and edge computing, enabling me to bridge development, validation and compliance in embedded systems.
aboutme.aboutme-profile-text: Methodical and results-driven, with strong adaptability in technically demanding environments. I value good engineering practices — clear documentation, version control and reproducible evidence — and I build tools and scripts to streamline workflows, reduce errors and accelerate validation cycles.

items.name: Cults3D — 3D Designs (CATIA V5 / scanning)
items.desc: Collection of 3D-printable models: original designs made in CATIA V5, 3D-scanned parts, and custom creations ready to download/print.

items.name: DGT — Traffic incidents & V16 beacons
items.desc: Traffic incidents map and V16 connected beacon context (DGT 3.0): HTML/JS frontend plus a Go proxy to consume data without CORS issues. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages and reproducible with Docker.

items.name: Face Recognition App
items.desc: Python face recognition app using computer vision libraries.

items.name: SDK Difference Scanner
items.desc: Python tool to scan and compare SDK differences (analysis and reporting).

items.name: ESP-NOW Gateway (Master thesis)
items.desc: ESP32 gateway with automatic connection based on ESP-NOW for IoT scenarios.

items.name: ESP-NOW Infrastructure (paper)
items.desc: Gateway extension with a custom data infrastructure to share data at the edge.

items.name: Torizon Qt6 Diagnostics — Apalis i.MX8
items.desc: Real-time Qt6/QML diagnostics dashboard on Apalis i.MX8 running Torizon OS. Displays SPI loopback status and I2C temperature (TMP75C) from inside a Docker container, using a decoupled C++/QML architecture via QObject and QTimer.

items.name: Torizon I2C — TMP75C (Apalis i.MX8)
items.desc: I2C temperature reading in C++ on Apalis i.MX8 running Torizon OS. Accesses the TMP75C sensor (address 0x4F) on i2c-4 via the Linux i2c-dev userspace interface (ioctl()), from inside a Docker container. Also includes the SPI loopback test as a combined validation binary.

items.name: Torizon SPI Loopback — Apalis i.MX8
items.desc: SPI loopback test in C++ for Apalis i.MX8 running Torizon OS. Verifies SPI bus access from a Docker container via the Linux spidev userspace interface (ioctl()): MOSI and MISO are physically bridged and every transmitted byte must come back unchanged.

education.edu1-title: M.Sc. in Teacher Training for Secondary Education, Vocational Training & Languages (Plan 2020)
education.edu1-description: Qualifying training in pedagogy and didactics for teaching in secondary education, sixth form, vocational training and language education, with particular emphasis on Technology and Computer Science. Covers subject-specific didactics, a school practicum, teaching innovation and the Master's Final Project. Practical applications include IoT educational resources using ESP8266, programming activities and the development of AulaVista, a Python/PySide6 tool for recording observations and supporting student progress monitoring.
education.edu2-description: Official certification focused on part design and mechanical CAD modelling with CATIA V5. Complements my background in electronics and embedded systems with three-dimensional design skills, subsequently applied to component modelling for UAV platforms and support for mechatronic integration and prototyping tasks.
education.edu3-description: Advanced training in the integration of electronics, control, software and mechatronic system design, connecting hardware development with programming and overall system operation. Work showcased in the portfolio includes a four-layer motor-controller PCB designed with MSP430 and Eagle, and an ESP32-based IoT gateway with automatic connection via ESP-NOW, identified as a master's final project.
education.edu4-title: Project Management for Solar PV Installations
education.edu4-description: Training focused on planning and managing solar photovoltaic installation projects, considering regulations, risks, applications and impact. Adds a management perspective to technical development by relating engineering decisions to project needs and implementation constraints.
education.edu5-title: B.Eng. in Electronics Engineering, Robotics and Mechatronics
education.edu5-description: Multidisciplinary training in electronics, robotics and automation, focused on understanding how a system's physical components, control and software interact. Provides the academic foundation for my subsequent work in firmware, hardware integration, sensing and IoT platforms, and a starting point for specialisation in embedded systems and technology validation.
education.edu6-description: Training in full-stack web programming and the fundamentals of web application development and administration. Combines PHP, JavaScript and MySQL to address the relationship between the user interface, server-side logic and information storage. Complements my technical profile with a foundation for developing data-connected web interfaces and tools.
education.edu7-description: Training in the operation of remotely piloted aircraft and associated radio communications. Complements my engineering background with an operational perspective on UAV systems, connected to my subsequent experience in conceptual design, component modelling and mechatronic integration of aerial platforms.

drone.title: Drone / Averon
drone.subtitle: 3D MODEL & CONTRIBUTION
drone.summary: During my part-time collaboration with Averon, I worked on the design and modelling of drones supporting the final concept of the project. The drone shown here was designed and modelled in CATIA V5, and is presented as an interactive 3D model.

hardware.title: Electronic Design
hardware.subtitle: PCB PROJECTS
hardware.dea-desc: 4-layer PCB designed with Eagle for the Advanced Electronic Design course of the M.Sc. in Mechatronics. The circuit implements a motor controller based on the Texas Instruments MSP430G2XX1 microcontroller, with power management distributed across independent layers to minimise interference between the signal and power stages. It includes overcurrent protection and an optimised layout to reduce EMI.
hardware.dea-3d: Interactive 3D model of the DEA PCB
hardware.consola-desc: 2-layer PCB designed with Altium Designer. A compact handheld console based on the ESP32 module, featuring integrated WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity. The design focuses on layout compactness and proper management of power rails, antenna routing and digital signals within a small form factor.
hardware.consola-3d: Interactive 3D model of the ESP32 Console

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.subtitle: PRACTICUM & EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES
teaching.rea-kicker: OPEN EDUCATIONAL RESOURCE · MASTER IN EDUCATION
teaching.rea-desc: Complete OER built with ExeLearning for the Learning and Teaching of Technology subject. Includes IoT theoretical foundations, hands-on activities with ESP8266 and BMP280, assessment rubrics and multimedia resources aimed at secondary and sixth-form students.
teaching.p4eso-desc: IoT introduction project: students flash MicroPython onto a Wemos D1 mini, read temperature and pressure from a BMP280 sensor over I2C, and publish the data to an MQTT broker in JSON format. Includes firmware, library and copy-paste-ready commands for Windows.
teaching.p1bach-title: Advanced IoT Node with LWT & auto-reconnect
teaching.p1bach-desc: Advanced version of the IoT node programmed in C++ with the Arduino framework. Implements automatic MQTT broker reconnection, Online/Offline status via LWT (Last Will & Testament) and periodic JSON data publishing. Aimed at sixth-form students with programming experience.
teaching.pnotebooks-desc: Collection of Python exercises in Jupyter Notebook format, organised by teaching units with progressive learning. Each folder includes 10 activities + a challenge and a solutions notebook, ready to use on Google Colab or locally.
teaching.aulavista-desc: Master's Final Project in Education. A Python desktop application (PySide6) to record student observations, track their progress throughout the school year and support data-driven pedagogical decisions. Designed for real classroom use by secondary school teachers.
